import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    
    if n == 0:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    
    if len(arr) != n:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    unique_sorted = sorted(set(arr))
    
    if not unique_sorted:
        print(-1)
        return
    
    print(unique_sorted[0])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
